scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.restart:api: sh -c 'for p in $(lsof -ti tcp:3789 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; exec node server.js'
scripts.restart:web: sh -c 'for p in $(lsof -ti tcp:5173 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; exec vite'
scripts.restart:all: sh -c 'for p in $(lsof -ti tcp:3789 2>/dev/null) $(lsof -ti tcp:5173 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; exec npm run dev:all'
